title: innerHTML assignment enables XSS
description: renderProductCard sets element.innerHTML to a string derived from product.name, which may contain user-controlled content. An attacker can inject script tags or event handlers via the product name.

title: JSON.parse with unsafe type assertion
description: parseAdminConfig casts the result of JSON.parse directly to AdminConfig with 'as'. No runtime validation ensures the parsed object matches the interface, so missing or wrong-typed fields will cause runtime errors downstream.

title: ReDoS via new RegExp from user input
description: The search endpoint constructs new RegExp(q, 'i') from the user-supplied query parameter. A crafted regex (e.g. '(a+)+$') can cause catastrophic backtracking, leading to denial of service.

title: Tautological .length >= 0 check
description: The condition ids.length >= 0 is always true for any array (length is never negative). The else branch on line 185 is dead code. The intended check was likely ids.length > 0.

title: Unsafe 'as any' cast bypasses type checking
description: The admin config endpoint casts req to 'any' to access user.admin, bypassing TypeScript's type system. If the auth middleware is misconfigured or missing, this silently reads undefined instead of producing a compile-time error.
